The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. ◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ THE WAR PATH — The body count, itemized. The System is not making this up — it was filming. THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Suburb and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).
